vch_lead: Say what to validate and with which profile. Nothing is written on this screen, except when you ask to save a profile.
vch_dirty: The working tree has uncommitted changes. Validation by commit does not see them; the others read the files as they are on disk.
vch_target_changed_hint: only what changed compared to the base
vch_target_commit_hint: the project as it is at a commit, without touching your tree
vch_target_compare_hint: what changed between two local references
vch_compare_note: For a pull request, use its two local references (for example origin/main and the PR branch already fetched). A URL or a number alone is not enough: JGates resolves the references into SHAs before building the plan.
vch_criteria_summary: {rules} rule(s) with their own criterion, {evidence} required evidence(s), {exceptions} recorded exception(s).
vch_criteria_default: The project defined no criteria of its own (policy.yml): the profile's and the tools' defaults apply.
vch_customize_lead: Checks of the profile {profile}, by category. Turning something off applies only to this run and writes nothing to the project.
vch_customize_nothing: No check turned off: this validation follows the whole profile.
vch_reduced_required: You turned off what the profile requires: {list}. The result does not count as approval of the whole profile.
vch_reduced_optional: You turned off checks of the profile: {list}. The result does not count as approval of the whole profile.
vch_reduced_scope: Applies only to this run; no project file changes.
vch_new_profile_help: Lowercase letters, numbers, dot, hyphen and underscore.
vch_builtin_note: The starter profiles are not changed; use Save as profile.
vch_skip_count: {count} check(s) turned off for this run only
